about.text: I am a Senior Researcher in XR Standards at LG Electronics CTO in Seoul, researching 3D Gaussian Splatting applications for XR and immersive media.

Before that I worked in 3D Graphics at LG Electronics: an interactive 3D Gaussian Splatting display demo with real-time parallax, automated optimization of high-fidelity 3D assets for web and mobile AR on LG.com, and an MCP-based tool, later a self-improving LangGraph agent, that lets marketers run that optimization on their own.
I received my M.S. and B.E. in Electronics Engineering from Sogang University. My graduate research covered camera pose estimation and multi-view stereo for omnidirectional imaging.

bullets.text: Researching 3D Gaussian Splatting applications for XR and immersive media.

Built an interactive display demo with 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructed from V-Ray renders, integrating HTC Vive tracking with Unreal Engine 5 nDisplay for real-time parallax; rendered in real time at 4K and presented to executive leadership.

Automated the optimization of high-fidelity 3D assets (3ds Max + V-Ray) for web and mobile AR: 200+ assets, average file size from about 4 GB to about 4 MB, deployed on LG.com (US) so customers can view TV products at real scale.
Developed an MCP-based tool that lets marketers run 3D asset optimization autonomously, then extended it into a self-improving LangGraph agent with agentic optimization loops.
